description: This file defines the ErrorResponse interface used for representing error responses related to Commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for handling headers, retrieving exceptions, and identifying the response type.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: A generic interface for error responses associated with Commands, providing methods to set headers, retrieve exceptions, and identify the response type.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the error response.

methods.name: getDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Retrieves the wrapped DittoRuntimeException associated with this error response.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Returns the response type, which is defined as ERROR for error responses.
